serverInfo.name: crawler-log-triage
serverInfo.title: Crawler Log Triage
serverInfo.description: Paste access-log lines: every bot named, fakes flagged, robots.txt and WAF rules. Free, no key. Aggregates by operator and category and flags the lines whose claim their address contradicts. Call triage_my_request first: it takes no arguments at all and triages the request you just sent as one line of a log. whoami and example are the other two zero-argument calls.
